grade_reason: He has spoken about AI only as an economic and competitive matter (a July 2025 Newsmax interview on AI and energy investment, December 2025 committee remarks about unleashing AI's potential so America wins the race); nothing found, in 2025 or 2026, acknowledges catastrophic risk from AI.
notes: All six required web searches ran this time, plus one on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors (seven in total). None of the topic searches (superintelligence, extinction, pause, China agreement, AI safety) found any statement by Meuser on those topics. An earlier attempt, when only one search ran, also opened meuser.house.gov directly: press release list pages 1 to 3 (20 February 2026 to 29 October 2026; none mention AI), the 18 September 2025 fraud and scams hearing release and the 9 June 2026 Chinese money laundering hearing release; in those, AI is mentioned by witnesses or in summary (in the June 2026 release he lists artificial intelligence among issues needing urgency, a passing mention), not as a statement on AI risk. Paraphrases left out: (1) the 15 July 2025 Newsmax page (https://meuser.house.gov/media/in-the-news/rep-meuser-newsmax-investors-put-billions-energy-ai) says he described energy and AI work in Pennsylvania as part of a competitive race; his direct quote there, 'This is a competitive race taking place. China would like to dominate,' does not mention AI. (2) The 10 December 2025 video page (https://meuser.house.gov/media/videos/meuser-delivers-remarks-house-financial-services-committee-hearing), opened this time, says in the office's own words that he 'spoke about our work to unleash AI's full potential' so 'America wins the race'; no direct quote of his on AI. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced 24 September 2026 by Rep. Casar): search results describe its cosponsors as Democrats and none name Meuser (a Republican); I did not open the Congress.gov cosponsor list, so this is not fully confirmed. Floor speeches and hearing transcripts were not checked beyond the pages above.
